Indica, written by the Greek traveler Megasthenes, describes the people, culture, and geography of India during the Maurya Empire. quick_notes.title: National Awards
quick_notes.detail: Bharat Ratna (Highest civilian - 1st: C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, C.V. Raman), Padma Awards, Jnanpith (Literature), Dadasaheb Phalke (Cinema).
quick_notes.explanation: National Awards are special honours given by the Government of India to recognise outstanding achievements in different fields. The Bharat Ratna, which means "Jewel of India," is the highest civilian award and was first given in 1954 to C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, and C.V. Raman. The Padma Awards, which include Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri, are the next highest civilian honours given for exceptional service in areas like art, sports, and public affairs. The Jnanpith Award is India's highest literary honour, given to writers for their outstanding contribution to Indian literature in any recognised language. The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is the highest award in Indian cinema, named after the father of Indian cinema, and is given for lifetime contribution to the film industry. Each of these awards has specific eligibility criteria and is announced annually on Republic Day or during special ceremonies.

quick_notes.title: Gallantry Awards
quick_notes.detail: Param Vir Chakra (Highest - 1st: Somnath Sharma), Ashok Chakra.
quick_notes.explanation: Gallantry Awards are special medals given to soldiers and citizens for showing great bravery. The Param Vir Chakra, or PVC, is the highest gallantry award in India, given for the most outstanding acts of bravery in the presence of the enemy on land, at sea, or in the air. The first person to receive the Param Vir Chakra was Major Somnath Sharma, who was honored for his courage during the 1947 war with Pakistan. The Ashok Chakra is the highest peacetime gallantry award, given for brave acts that are not in the face of an enemy, such as saving lives during a disaster or fighting terrorists. Both awards can be given to military personnel or civilians, and they are among the most respected honors in the country.

quick_notes.title: International Awards
quick_notes.detail: Nobel Prize (1st Indian: Tagore), Oscar (1st: Bhanu Athaiya), Pulitzer (Journalism), Ramon Magsaysay (Asia's Nobel).
quick_notes.explanation: The Nobel Prize is a set of international awards given for achievements in physics, chemistry, medicine, literature, and peace, with the first Indian winner being Rabindranath Tagore in 1913 for literature. The Oscar, also called the Academy Award, is an award for excellence in filmmaking, and the first Indian to win an Oscar was Bhanu Athaiya, who won for Best Costume Design in 1983. The Pulitzer Prize is a major award for journalism, literature, and music in the United States, primarily recognizing American work. The Ramon Magsaysay Award, often called Asia's Nobel Prize, is given to individuals and organizations in Asia for outstanding public service and achievements in various fields.

lesson_pages.intro: Gallantry Awards are special medals given to soldiers and citizens for showing great bravery. The Param Vir Chakra, or PVC, is the highest gallantry award in India, given for the most outstanding acts of bravery in the presence of the enemy on land, at sea, or in the air. The first person to receive the Param Vir Chakra was Major Somnath Sharma, who was honored for his courage during the 1947 war with Pakistan. The Ashok Chakra is the highest peacetime gallantry award, given for brave acts that are not in the face of an enemy, such as saving lives during a disaster or fighting terrorists. Both awards can be given to military personnel or civilians, and they are among the most respected honors in the country.
lesson_pages.title: Gallantry Awards

lesson_pages.intro: The Nobel Prize is a set of international awards given for achievements in physics, chemistry, medicine, literature, and peace, with the first Indian winner being Rabindranath Tagore in 1913 for literature. The Oscar, also called the Academy Award, is an award for excellence in filmmaking, and the first Indian to win an Oscar was Bhanu Athaiya, who won for Best Costume Design in 1983. The Pulitzer Prize is a major award for journalism, literature, and music in the United States, primarily recognizing American work. The Ramon Magsaysay Award, often called Asia's Nobel Prize, is given to individuals and organizations in Asia for outstanding public service and achievements in various fields.
lesson_pages.title: International Awards
